# Getting help

- **Questions, ideas, feedback**: use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ymauray/stardog/discussions).
- **Bugs**: open an [issue](https://github.com/ymauray/stardog/issues/new/choose) with the bug report template.
- **Security problems**: report them privately, see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

How to play and the controls are described in the [README](../README.md).
